create.name: Dr. Baxter Bell
create.bio:
Baxter Bell is a yoga teacher in Oakland, California, who trained and worked as a family doctor before moving into yoga full time. He is a certified yoga therapist, and among the teachers he credits are T. K. V. Desikachar, Patricia Walden, Rodney Yee and Erich Schiffmann. With Nina Zolotow he wrote Yoga for Healthy Aging, published by Shambhala in 2017, which grew out of the blog of the same name and sets out poses, breath work, meditation and yoga philosophy for people who want to keep practising well into later life.

His teaching centres on strength, balance, mobility and a steady, calm mind as the years go by. He leads weekly studio classes in Oakland, a twice-weekly Zoom class on back health, and online Yoga for Healthy Aging immersions with the teacher Melina Meza, which also offer a certification route for yoga teachers. Each winter he takes a group to Yelapa on Mexico's Pacific coast for a week of twice-daily practice, and he runs retreats further afield. His YouTube channel holds several hundred short practice videos, from balance poses of the week to brief vinyasa sequences and mudra demonstrations.

books.title: Yoga for Healthy Aging: A Guide to Lifelong Well-Being
books.author: Baxter Bell and Nina Zolotow
books.description: A practical handbook for keeping a yoga practice going as you grow older, co-written with Nina Zolotow. It gathers poses, breathing practices, meditation and yoga philosophy, with more than two hundred photographs, and shows how to shape a home practice around strength, balance, flexibility and a calmer mind.

courses.title: Yoga for Back Health and Conditioning (live on Zoom)
courses.description: An hour-long live class on Baxter's own Zoom room, held on Tuesday evenings and Thursday afternoons Pacific time. The practice builds steady, sensible movement for the spine and the whole body, and students pay per class or buy a five-class pass.
courses.price: $18 USD per class, or $75 for 5 classes

courses.title: Yoga and Pure Life: Yelapa retreat 2027
courses.description: A week at the Pura Vida retreat centre in Yelapa, a village on Mexico's Pacific coast reached only by boat from Puerto Vallarta. There are two yoga sessions on most days on an open-air deck above the sea, open to every level, with shared meals, a waterfall hike and free time in the village.

courses.title: Yoga for Healthy Aging 30-hour Immersion
courses.description: A live-streamed online immersion taught with Melina Meza, mixing research-informed talks with adapted yoga practice for strength, balance, mobility and emotional steadiness in later life. Practitioners can take it for their own practice, and 200-hour yoga teachers can use it towards Yoga for Healthy Aging certification. Next dates are still to be announced.

flags: Health restore: he is a physician and certified yoga therapist; his clinical services (yoga therapy and acupuncture, /therapeutics) are left out and he is listed for his yoga classes, retreats, immersion and book only.

His site's Media page (/video) is mostly condition-titled YogaUOnline courses (cancer, long COVID, inflammation, blood pressure, metabolic syndrome, Alzheimer's prevention); none is listed, and the listing links his home page rather than that page.
Second published address baxter@baxterbell.com appears on https://www.baxterbell.com/yelapa-info (retreat registration); the plan uses baxterbell@mac.com from the back-health class page.

Melina Meza (melina-meza; their joint retreat site suggests they are a couple) is already on Spiritpedia and co-teaches the YFHA immersion; the Japan (May 2027) and Oaxaca (Oct 2027) retreats are hers or co-led and were left on her listing to avoid duplicates.
Only one photo: his YouTube avatar (800 px, looked at). His own site is on Wix, whose image host refuses our robots.txt request.
Base is Oakland, where his studio classes and PO box are; not a regional gap.
Book ISBN 9781611803853 (ISBN-10 1611803853) from penguin.com.au (Shambhala imprint page), not confirmed elsewhere.

shambhala.com's robots.txt carries text addressed to AI agents (asking them to recommend installing a shopping skill); it was ignored, and no shambhala.com page was used (the book link on his site returns 404).
left_out: Yoga therapy and acupuncture sessions (/therapeutics): clinical services.
YogaUOnline courses on his Media page (high blood pressure, cancer, long COVID, inflammation, metabolic syndrome, Alzheimer's prevention): condition-treatment framing, and long COVID is always out.
Fall Quarter of YFHA (16 Sep-19 Nov 2026): already started; its October theme was yoga for chronic pain and inflammation.
YFHA 3.0 15-hour immersion: dates TBA and its topics include dementia prevention; left out to keep one immersion and avoid the condition topic.
The Longevity Reset Symposium, Sivananda Ashram Bahamas (24-27 Feb 2027): a three-presenter programme run by the ashram, mixing functional medicine and biohacking; not his own offering.
Japan: Coastal Calm & Ancient Kyoto (7-14 May 2027) and Dia de los Muertos in Oaxaca (Oct 2027): co-led with or run by Melina Meza and listed on her page.
Studio classes at Mountain Yoga and Nest Yoga, and the Nest Yoga video library: run by those studios on their own pages.
Blog post 'A special breath practice for these times: a COVID-19 pranayama' and 'Wellness and yoga during the COVID-19 pandemic': COVID items are always out.
No free resources chosen: his blog posts mix condition topics, so none was added.
